info.name: Lei e il marito perfetto
info.plot: L'avvocato d'élite Qin Shi e il casalingo residente Yang Hua che si sono "sposati" per i propri scopi trovano inaspettatamente il vero amore l'uno nell'altro. Insieme, camminano mano nella mano verso una vita felice e fruttuosa.

trailers.name: She And Her Perfect Husband | Trailer | Yang Mi & Xu Kai High-Sweet Interaction! | 爱的二八定律 | ENG SUB

translations.value: L'avvocato d'élite Qin Shi e il casalingo residente Yang Hua che si sono "sposati" per i propri scopi trovano inaspettatamente il vero amore l'uno nell'altro. Insieme, camminano mano nella mano verso una vita felice e fruttuosa.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Qin Shi seems to be the winner of life. Just turned 30, she's already a senior associate at Honesty & Prudence, with a husband that everyone's jealous of. But Qin Shi is not satisfied yet with all these. What she is aiming for is to join the Corporate Department of the company. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: The news is soon spread around the office. Everyone immediately adjusts their attitude. They all know that whoever is able to get Ms. Lan as their client will be able to go to the 11th floor. Li Dai will be bringing an assistant to the 11th floor, so everybody wants to be that assistant. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Before going to the charity gala, Qin Shi first goes to visit Yang Hua's family with him. What she's trying to do is to get Yang Hua's mother to surrender. But things are not as simple as she expects, because Yang Hua's mother knows her son too well. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Qin Shi escapes but is soon taken away by Tao Junhui. Junhui questions why Qin Shi is here. He wonders where Qin Shi's ambition in the past has gone. Then Yang Hua turns up and rescues Qin Shi like a knight. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Yang Hua remembers his luggage is still at Qin Shi's, so he calls her. Qin Shi is very concerned about the problem with Lowe & Magnolia that Yang Hua talked about. Yang Hua then shows his analysis of why there's something fishy about the company. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Honesty & Prudence is now in danger. Jin finally decides to keep Lowe's secret for the sake of the law firm. After learning that the analysis is made by Yang Hua, Jin immediately asks Qin Shi to keep Yang Hua's mouth shut. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Tao Junhui turns up near Qin Shi's place, where the two used to live together. He has been thinking a lot about their past. Then he bumps into Yang Hua, who is on his way home. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Qin Shi receives an email from Wu Fei on the way to work, and immediately gets an urgent call from Tang Yihui. Zhao Dan is coming to the office, and she needs Qin Shi's help. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 9
episodes.plot: The relationship between the allies has subtle changes. Meanwhile, Li Dai finds out a surprising truth about their real relationship relying on the information given by Yang Hua's mother. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 10
episodes.plot: Qin Shi joins a party with Yang Hua, who is uncomfortable with it due to his identity. Li Dai also attends the party as a candidate for the partnership of the law firm. Li Dai wants to investigate the secret between them. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 11
episodes.plot: Mentre Qin Shi e Meimei stanno giocando, Meimei si traveste improvvisamente dopo aver ricevuto una telefonata. Anche se Meimei sembra non curarsi di Wenyu, vuole comunque dare una lezione a Vivian.

translations.value: Mentre Qin Shi e Meimei stanno giocando, Meimei si traveste improvvisamente dopo aver ricevuto una telefonata. Anche se Meimei sembra non curarsi di Wenyu, vuole comunque dare una lezione a Vivian.

episodes.name: Episodio 12
episodes.plot: Li Dai e Qin Shi fingono di essere riluttanti ad accettare il caso. Tuttavia, ordinano ai loro assistenti di agire quando tornano nel loro ufficio e sperano di assumere il caso con successo. Nel frattempo, Qin Shi ricorda che Tang Yihui le ha detto di non accettare il caso poiché è una patata bollente.

episodes.name: Episodio 13
episodes.plot: Qin Shi and Yanghua rush to the airport and found Ms. Lan waiting for Pang Dingfang. They accompany her till midnight until Ms. Lan understands that she's been deceived. Ms. Lan decides to file for divorce and requests Qin Shi to take this case.

episodes.name: Episodio 14
episodes.plot: Tao Junhui asks Qin Shi for a meet-up after work. Meanwhile, in the office, Qin Shi receives a parcel, threatening her to stay out of it. As she is on her way to meet Junhui, some gangsters appear. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 15
episodes.plot: Li Dai mostra a Qin Shi una registrazione riguardante il suo segreto per dimostrare che lei e Yang Hua non si sono ancora sposati. Li Dai dice che non esporrà il suo segreto in segno di gratitudine per il suo aiuto. Tuttavia, Li Dai spera che lei abbandoni la competizione. Qin Shi discute la soluzione con Yang Hua a casa.

translations.value: Li Dai mostra a Qin Shi una registrazione riguardante il suo segreto per dimostrare che lei e Yang Hua non si sono ancora sposati. Li Dai dice che non esporrà il suo segreto in segno di gratitudine per il suo aiuto. Tuttavia, Li Dai spera che lei abbandoni la competizione. Qin Shi discute la soluzione con Yang Hua a casa.

episodes.name: Episodio 16
episodes.plot: Qin Shi questions why Yang Hua suddenly suggests getting married with her. Yang Hua pretends not to like her and also lists the benefits of their sham marriage. Yang Hua even prepares a prenuptial agreement. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 17
episodes.plot: Qin Shi tells the truth about the breakup with Tao Junhui to her family. Since Tao's family regards the children of a broken family as bad, she could not tell him the real situation about her family. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 18
episodes.plot: Qin Shi and Yang Hua hurry to the Bureau of Civil Affairs to get a marriage certificate after getting their household registration booklets. Actually, Both of them want to start a romantic relationship but they are hesitant because of the Prenuptial Agreement. (Source: Viu)

episodes.name: Episodio 19
episodes.plot: Yang Hua confesses his love to Qin Shi on the phone after getting drunk. Yang Hua's best friend tells her not to hurt Yang Hua when she pick him up in the restaurant.

episodes.name: Episodio 20
episodes.plot: When Qin Shi is tormented by unfamiliar economic-related laws and regulations, she receives a call from Meimei. Meimei regrets to let Wenyu manage the business. However, Wenyu is not good at management, and someone calls Meimei to pick up his slack.

episodes.name: Episodio 21
episodes.plot: Qin Shi cannot believe that her sham marriage will come true, she is so nervous about it. Yang Hua always keeps her company and supports her although there are a lot of complicated steps and process in the wedding.

episodes.name: Episodio 22
episodes.plot: Yang Hua is hard to find a job so he hopes his friend, Cai Liang to help him. Cai Liang tells Yang Hua that there is a position in his department but it may not be suitable for him since he needs to communicate with others frequently. Unbelievably, Yang Hua accepts his recommendation. Yang Hua's parents are happy with it.

episodes.name: Episodio 23
episodes.plot: Yang Hua hates to see Qin Shi who works at the Archives, He also feels jealous when Tao Junhui cares about her. Qin Shi tells him that Tao Junhui believes she has an affair with Yang Hua when they break up before.

episodes.name: Episodio 24
episodes.plot: On behalf of Li Dai's client, Cao Yiren, she discusses prenuptial agreement with Qin Shi's Firm. As the enemy of Qin Shi, Li Dai knows her well, also she tells Qin Shi about the rich woman who buy a watch to thank her client only. Thus, there is nothing between them.

episodes.name: Episodio 25
episodes.plot: Wu Fei finds out about the contract between her father and her boss, Tang Yihui. Her father hopes to deter her from getting married to Tao Junhui but he fails. Therefore, Wu Fei's father plays his trump card and posted to her some photos capturing intimate behavior between Tao Junhui and Qin Shi.

episodes.name: Episodio 26
episodes.plot: After receiving the photo, Wu Fei confronted Tang Yihui angrily but Tang says suspicion and jealousy are useless at this moment. A prenuptial agreement is a touchstone for testing their relationship between them.

episodes.name: Episodio 27
episodes.plot: Tao Junhui and Wu Fei meet each other's parents in the restaurant. Junhui's mother is pleased that Mr. Wu bought an apartment. But when she realizes Junhui signed the prenup, she feels that Mr. Wu did not respect her son.

episodes.name: Episodio 28
episodes.plot: Qin Shi and Yang Hua arrive the ballroom only to realize this is not a private party, but an award ceremony which has gathered the people of finance industry. Yang Hua who is usually not a social person, becomes the center of attention.

episodes.name: Episodio 29
episodes.plot: Yang Hua has inferiority complex about his past years. Qin Shi blames herself for bringing him to socialize. Yang Hua thinks this is not her fault. Instead, he is willing to tell her about his experience for the first time.

episodes.name: Episodio 30
episodes.plot: Qin Shi is annoyed with Wang Jiesen due to his ulterior motives. Luckily, she knows where Tao Junhui will go for investigation so she follows him. She can get rid of Wang Jiesen while she can step in the case.

episodes.name: Episodio 31
episodes.plot: When Tao Junhui and Wu Fei are having dinner, he proposes to withdraw from He Dongna's case. However, Wu Fei tells him that she has already made a deal with Tang Yihui. If he can win in the this case, he will get promoted.

episodes.name: Episodio 32
episodes.plot: Li Dai tells Qin Shi about Yanghua who may be framed by someone else, instead of Shao Jianxiang. It makes Qin Shi very concerned. Wang Jiesen always harasses Qin Shi, and also invite her to travel to Hangzhou together.

episodes.name: Episodio 33
episodes.plot: Qin Shi questions that why she is gifted a luxury car and prize by her company. Her colleague tells her the truth about Yang Hua's injury. In order to protecting Qin Shi, Yang Hua shows the evidence about illegal practice of Wang Jiesen to Mr. Jin.

episodes.name: Episodio 34
episodes.plot: Qin Shi and Yang Hua are invited to join the gathering by Tang Yihui. At the same time, Qin Shi is alert that there will be a good news. Unsurprisingly, Tang Yihui announces they get the investment and two lawyers enter the Top100 in the country. She also announces Qin Shi gets promoted to be one of the partner of the firm.

episodes.name: Episodio 35
episodes.plot: Yang Hua discovers there is a trap so he immediately tries to prevent Qin Shi from signing the contract. However, Qin Shi has already confessed the truth to her boss, Mr. Jin, even voices for the unfair treatment of female workers in the firm.

episodes.name: Episodio 36
episodes.plot: Tao Junhui confesses his love to Qin Shi after getting drunk. He also requests her to end the sham marriage with Yang Hua and then get married with him. In order to get rid of Tao Junhui, she says she is reluctant to remarry or divorce. Unexpectedly, Yang Hua hears her words.

episodes.name: Episodio 37
episodes.plot: Tao Junhui refused to undertake the labor dispute with Yao Yao for Tianhang. Tang Yihui called Qin Shi back to the law firm for this task. She also promised that Qin Shi would be able to return to the 11th floor as long as she handled the case well.

episodes.name: Episodio 38
episodes.plot: Qin Shi visita Yao Yao. Lei aveva ripetuto mentalmente innumerevoli volte la dichiarazione di cooperazione per la giustizia, purché aggiungesse alla fine una condizione che Yao Yao si tenesse lontana da Yang Hua, ma quando l'ha detto, è diventata una reprimenda e una domanda impazienti...

translations.value: Qin Shi visita Yao Yao. Lei aveva ripetuto mentalmente innumerevoli volte la dichiarazione di cooperazione per la giustizia, purché aggiungesse alla fine una condizione che Yao Yao si tenesse lontana da Yang Hua, ma quando l'ha detto, è diventata una reprimenda e una domanda impazienti...

episodes.name: Episodio 39
episodes.plot: Tang Yihui, who finds out that Qin Shi helps Yao Yao to sue her previous employer for the sexual harassment, compels Qin Shi to stop it immediately. Qin Shi disdains to stay, and also chooses to resign as she thinks the firm becomes unprincipled.

episodes.name: Episodio 40
episodes.plot: Qin Shi sa che Yang Hua le dà costantemente una mano con la causa. Qin Shi gli strappa il telefono mentre Gangzi sta chiacchierando con Yang Hua al telefono. Chiede a Yang Hua di scegliere tra lei e Yao Yao. Per stimolare Qin Shi, Yao Yao dice che tornerà in Australia con suo figlio e Yang Hua, addirittura tenendolo per mano, lui che compare fuori dal ristorante.
